name: com.rubickanov.report
description: Bug reports over the Sentry Unity SDK: the SDK started by the game with its values (no IP, no machine name, a random install id), each kind of error once a session under a cap, the end of the log attached, hangs ignored while the game says it is busy, the moment's screenshot and a note as a feedback, the frame rate as metrics. Without a DSN it stays quietly off. The game provides io.sentry.unity and draws its own report window.
